original_question: Let Omega be a bounded hyperconvex domain and let g_Omega(z,w) be its pluricomplex Green function with pole at w. Determine whether g_Omega(z,w) converges locally uniformly to 0 as the pole w approaches the boundary of Omega.
target_in_paper: Question 27 (Błocki) in Section 3.7, “Regularity of the pluricomplex Green function.” ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper’s exact target: it uses a bounded hyperconvex domain, the one-pole pluricomplex Green function g_Ω(z,w), and asks exactly whether this function tends locally uniformly to 0 as the pole w approaches the boundary. This matches the official formulation of Question 27 almost verbatim. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
missing_details: The ambient setting Ω ⊂ ℂ^n is implicit in your draft but explicit in the paper’s surrounding context. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

For a fully stand-alone question, the paper’s notion of hyperconvexity should be spelled out: Ω is a bounded domain admitting a negative plurisubharmonic exhaustion ρ such that each sublevel set {ρ < c} is relatively compact in Ω for every c < 0. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The exact definition of the pluricomplex Green function should be included, namely as the supremum over plurisubharmonic u ≤ 0 having at most a logarithmic pole at w: u(ζ) ≤ log||ζ−w|| + C_u. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The phrase “converges locally uniformly to 0” should be made explicit as convergence of the functions g_Ω(·,w) to 0 uniformly on every compact subset of Ω as w approaches ∂Ω from within Ω. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
refined_question: Let Ω ⊂ ℂ^n be a bounded hyperconvex domain, i.e. there exists a negative plurisubharmonic exhaustion function ρ on Ω such that {ρ < c} is relatively compact in Ω for every c < 0. For each pole w ∈ Ω, define the pluricomplex Green function by g_Ω(z,w) := sup{u(z) : u is plurisubharmonic on Ω, u ≤ 0 on Ω, and u(ζ) ≤ log||ζ−w|| + C_u for all ζ ∈ Ω, for some constant C_u depending on u}. Is it true that g_Ω(·,w) converges to 0 locally uniformly on Ω as w approaches the boundary ∂Ω? ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
justification: This draft clearly targets Section 3.7 rather than the introduction or Section 1. In that section, the paper first gives the exact one-pole definition of g_Ω(z,w), then immediately states Question 27 (Błocki): whether, for a bounded hyperconvex domain, g_Ω(z,w) converges locally uniformly to 0 as the pole tends to ∂Ω. The nearby contextual sentence records only the already-known boundary behavior for fixed pole w, namely lim_{z→∂Ω} g_Ω(z,w)=0, and the following remark that the question is only interesting for very rough boundaries is motivational, not part of the formal statement. The meaning of “hyperconvex” is supplied earlier in Section 3.5. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
